daily_internal.system_prompt_append:
# Required Output Structure
Do not write a title line; the application adds the title, subject and date.
Start directly with the first section. Use exactly these level-2 headings, in this order, with no others:
## Deliverables
## Accomplishments
## In-Progress Items
## Blockers
## Risks
## Need Help?
## Tomorrow's Plan
Under each heading write '-' bullets only.

weekly_client.system_prompt_append:
# Required Output Structure
Do not write a title line; the application adds the title, subject and date.
Start directly with the first section. Use exactly these level-2 headings, in this order, with no others:
## 1. What are you working on?
## 2. When do you plan to complete these tasks?
## 3. Do you have any Risks or Blockers?
## 4. Did you receive any requests you are unsure of?
## 5. Location of Artifacts
Under each heading write sub-items a., b., c. only.
